nested-classes-basics.title: Nested classes
nested-classes-basics.short: Declare a class inside another class
nested-classes-basics.summary: Use nested classes to keep closely related types together.
nested-classes-basics.why: A nested class can express implementation structure without adding another top-level type to the package namespace.
nested-classes-basics.tips: Use a static nested class when it does not need an enclosing instance; non-static inner classes retain one.

pattern-switch-basics.title: Pattern matching in switch
pattern-switch-basics.summary: Use type patterns directly in switch cases.
pattern-switch-basics.why: Pattern switches combine type testing, binding, and branching without a chain of instanceof checks and casts.
pattern-switch-basics.tips: Keep cases exhaustive where required and order guarded or specific cases so their intent stays clear.

map-replace-all-values.title: Update map values with Map.replaceAll
map-replace-all-values.short: Replace every value with a function
map-replace-all-values.summary: Transform all values in a Map in place.
map-replace-all-values.why: replaceAll computes a new value from each key and current value without manually iterating entrySet and assigning each entry.
map-replace-all-values.tips: Keep the remapping function focused on value transformation and avoid structural changes to the same Map while it runs.

string-strip-leading.title: Strip leading whitespace
string-strip-leading.short: Remove leading Unicode whitespace with String.stripLeading
string-strip-leading.summary: Remove Unicode whitespace from the start of a string while preserving its trailing side.
string-strip-leading.why: stripLeading is useful when leading whitespace should be normalized without changing meaningful whitespace at the end.
string-strip-leading.tips: Use strip for both ends or stripTrailing when only trailing whitespace should be removed.

input-mismatch-exception.title: InputMismatchException
input-mismatch-exception.short: Scanner input does not match the requested type
input-mismatch-exception.summary: Handle Scanner input that cannot be converted to the requested token type.
input-mismatch-exception.why: Methods such as nextInt throw InputMismatchException when the next token exists but does not match the expected format.
input-mismatch-exception.tips: For interactive input, check hasNextInt or read text first and validate it explicitly.

no-such-file-exception.title: NoSuchFileException
no-such-file-exception.short: A requested filesystem path does not exist
no-such-file-exception.summary: Handle missing paths reported by NIO file operations.
no-such-file-exception.why: Files operations commonly report a missing file with NoSuchFileException, a more specific IOException subtype.
no-such-file-exception.tips: Do not rely on an exists check for correctness when another process can change the filesystem between checking and opening.

incompatible-return-type-override.title: Incompatible return type when overriding
incompatible-return-type-override.short: An override must use a compatible return type
incompatible-return-type-override.summary: Use the same return type or a covariant subtype when overriding a method.
incompatible-return-type-override.why: Java permits covariant return types, but an unrelated return type does not satisfy the inherited method contract.
incompatible-return-type-override.tips: Check the inherited signature and choose the declared return type or one of its subtypes.

non-static-variable-static-context.title: Non-static variable from a static context
non-static-variable-static-context.summary: Do not access an instance field directly from a static method.
non-static-variable-static-context.why: A static method has no implicit this object, so Java cannot know which instance field should be read.
non-static-variable-static-context.tips: Make the operation an instance method, pass an instance explicitly, or make the state static only when it truly belongs to the class.

unchecked-varargs-generic-array-warning.title: Unchecked generic varargs warning
unchecked-varargs-generic-array-warning.short: Generic varargs can expose unsafe array operations
unchecked-varargs-generic-array-warning.summary: Avoid unsafe generic array creation through varargs parameters.
unchecked-varargs-generic-array-warning.why: Varargs are implemented with arrays, while parameterized generic types are not reifiable, so some generic varargs declarations cannot be fully checked at runtime.
unchecked-varargs-generic-array-warning.tips: Prefer a collection or fixed parameters when practical; use SafeVarargs only when the implementation is actually type safe.

bigdecimal-equals-scale.title: BigDecimal.equals also compares scale
bigdecimal-equals-scale.short: Use compareTo when numeric equality is intended
bigdecimal-equals-scale.summary: Distinguish BigDecimal representation equality from numeric comparison.
bigdecimal-equals-scale.why: BigDecimal.equals considers both value and scale, so 1.0 and 1.00 are numerically equal but not equal according to equals.
bigdecimal-equals-scale.tips: Use compareTo == 0 for numeric equality and equals when scale is intentionally part of the representation.
